'''January 2000 Greensboro tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Greensboro, NC on 16 January 2000. [[Kristian Heugh]] won it. It is known from Leonard Mitchell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d190">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-19-greensboro-north-carolina-01-16-00d190/ greensboro-north-carolina-01-16-00], DeckTech (Leonard "Master Yoda" Mitchell, 19 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-19-greensboro-north-carolina-01-16-00d190/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Greensboro, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kristian Heugh]]
